data.desc: Amwell offers health plans and healthcare organizations a single, comprehensive, technology-enabled care platform. We use technology to provide consumers with better access to more convenient, affordable, and effective care. The Amwell Platform includes software and services that power many clinical programmes from Amwell and our growing number of partners. Our platform allows consumers to experience unified, personalised, and simple access to diversified clinical programs across the care continuum. As more people seek care online and more clinical programmes become available, we offer integrated, future-ready, consistent solutions. The Amwell Platform is proven, operating at a large scale, enabling care for millions while delivering dependable outcomes.
